fields.description: QA validation run — non-production. Do not include in daily close.
Billing managed by channel partner Paymatic - do NOT create internal billing setup tasks
Credit hold — AR team must approve before closing any new deals. Do not process through daily close until hold is lifted.

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_close_process", "from_": "vp-sales@company.example.com", "to": ["sales-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "Daily Close Process Runbook", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_close_process
来源：vp-sales@company.example.com
收件人：sales-team@company.example.com
日期：未标注
主题：Daily Close Process Runbook
Team,

Here is the daily close process:
1. Find all completed DocuSign envelopes from TODAY only
2. Update each opportunity to Closed Won with the contract amount
3. Send a welcome/thank-you email to each signer
4. Create a billing setup task for each deal (check account notes first - some accounts have partner billing)
5. Post a combined win announcement to #wins with total contract value

IMPORTANT: Only process envelopes completed TODAY. Prior days were already processed. Skip any envelopes flagged as QA/test runs in their description. Also check account notes before closing — some accounts have credit holds or partner billing that affect the close process.

Best,
VP Sales"}
